ctx.x: I think he was out of St. Louis, I mean, St. Louis, Missouri. I really believe he was out of St. Louis. Let me see the jack in a second. Yeah, Bob Schaffner, he's also out of St. Louis, good trumpet man, still is. He's still active today.
